title: The Source: public discovery corpus (KEI-912, KEI-919)
description: data/corpus/projects.jsonl rows. corpus-validate checks field sets exactly (source_pipeline/corpus.py PROJECT_KEYS, LIVE_KEYS) and validates `identity` against $defs/identity, then checks it referentially (source_pipeline/identity.py check). Methodology: docs/CORPUS.md.

repo_key.description: host/owner/name, lower case; for an upstream outside the three repository hosts, host/path

identity.description: KEI-919 identity resolution: null when there is nothing to say. Every mark traces to a held fact (a name, a description, a GitHub flag); nothing is estimated.

renamed_to.description: the repository's current address when the row's id is an earlier name; it is also an alias

fork_of.description: the parent's corpus id when the parent is a project here, else its address

fork_parent_in_corpus.description: true: never present this fork as a separate replacement candidate for its parent

mirror.description: GitHub flags it a mirror, or its own description says it mirrors another repository

mirror_of.description: the upstream it names; a mirror of an upstream held here is collapsed into it (and appears under merged there)

merged.description: rows collapsed into this one; each id is now an alias of it

siblings.description: the same owner's other repositories of one project

sibling_primary.description: where a name lookup for the project should land
